description: This file defines the DataNormSparsifier class, a specialized subclass of BaseDataSparsifier, implementing techniques for sparsifying data tensors based on L1 or L2 norms. It contains methods for computing masks to zero out data blocks either at the data level or at the block level, employing either the L1 or L2 norm for the sparsification process. The class appears to be part of a pruning or model compression module within a PyTorch-based project.

classes.name: DataNormSparsifier
classes.description: A PyTorch sparsifier class that zeros-out data blocks based on their computed L1 or L2 norms. It supports mask updating based on sparsity level and block shape, enabling structured sparsification of tensors for model pruning.

methods.description: Computes a mask that combines scattering operations and folding to produce a sparse mask over data based on block indices and shape.

methods.name: __get_block_level_mask(self, data, sparse_block_shape, zeros_per_block)
methods.description: Generates a mask for data, zeroing out elements within each block according to the specified zeros per block. Handles padding and unfolding of tensors to operate on blocks.

methods.name: __get_data_level_mask(self, data, sparsity_level, sparse_block_shape)
methods.description: Creates a mask by evaluating the normalized data (via average pooling) and zeroing out entire blocks based on the sparsity level.

methods.description: Updates the sparsifier's mask based on the data tensor, sparsity parameters, and mask type (block or data level). Supports both L1 and L2 norms and enforces constraints on zeros per block.
